context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly recognizes a decision already settled by an existing ADR as out of scope for this skill, checks for the ADR before doing any research work, and redirects to the ADR-supersession path instead of producing a duplicate evaluation.

checklist.name: Checks for an existing ADR first
checklist.description: Looks for a governing ADR before dispatching any research

checklist.name: Recognizes out-of-scope condition
checklist.description: Explicitly identifies this as the 'already settled by an ADR' non-use case

checklist.name: No subagent dispatched
checklist.description: Does not run the research/validation workflow for an already-settled decision

checklist.name: Correct redirect
checklist.description: Points to superseding the ADR as the correct path, not a new finding

checklist.name: Handles new-evidence case correctly
checklist.description: If new evidence is claimed, still routes to ADR supersession rather than a duplicate finding
